extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors (especially new users attempting to create an article)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who attempt to create a new Wikipedia page (here: 'Kennedy Center Comedy'), including account/confirmation requirements, searching for existing coverage, and next steps if a page was deleted or not yet visible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternative options if you cannot create articles directly: use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard or request page as alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are not able to create the article directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed), you may use the article wizard or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitting a draft via the article wizard allows review; requesting a new article can prompt others to create it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for the title in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Wikipedia search to avoid duplicate pages and to find the correct canonical title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for incoming links
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding incoming links can show whether the topic already exists under another name or has been referenced elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delay / caching may hide newly created pages
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to see recently created pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure correct capitalization and set up redirects when appropriate so readers find the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: If the page was deleted, check deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion reasons in the log to understand policy or content issues and to inform revisions or appeals.
